_about: ZONES v1 (lane laneZONES), read by Assets/Scripts/Zones/ZoneData.cs. SHIPS DARK: enabled=false means the game is exactly the old duel (scene reload per fight, opponents.json ladder). enabled=true turns the game into walking zones: monsters stand at spawn spots, a fight starts when you walk into a creature's aggro radius, a kill is stored as a real-world respawn time (UTC ms) in the save, and a dead creature simply reads as alive again once that time has passed (computed when someone looks, no server loop, V1/V3 lazy-respawn pattern). Gates carry you to another zone behind a flash, no camera cut. Units: metres, degrees, seconds. A spot pos is [x, z] (ground height is found by a raycast), [] = where the scene already put the object.

clock._about: a saved respawn time further in the future than respawnMaxS + guardSeconds (clock set back) is pulled in to now + respawnMaxS

persistence._about: Application.persistentDataPath. Harness runs (MenuCfg.Harness) never read or write it. Rows use the Supabase zone_spawns field names (zone = instance, generation, respawnAtMs = respawn_at) so a later store is a swap of storage, not of data.

hp._about: RECOMMENDED POLICY (Dom decides). onCross: carry = the gate heals nothing. outOfCombat: slow regen on SIM TICKS (not frame time) after delaySeconds with nobody engaged, up to ceilFrac of max in the zone you stand in (danger zones stop short of full; standing within hearthRadius of a hearth service refills fast to full, which is why the start zone stays worth returning to). onDeath: wake at hearth at full hp, loot kept, wounds cleared (scene reload), every monster timer untouched.

respawn._about: REVIVE v1 (laneSEAMLESS): Joan's in-world respawn, no scene reload. enabled false = old death (3 s black + GameLoop.Retry). delayS = lying time before she stands up; rule arrive = the zone's arrive spot (rows below), hearth = the zone's hearth service spot; hpFrac = share of max hp; coverS / coverMax = the dark dip before she stands up (alpha max); foeReset spawn = the creatures that were fighting her go back to their spawn at full hp after foeResetDelayS (keep = they stay); fallbackAfterS = if the revive cannot happen (finisher still running, ragdoll cannot be put back) the old reload runs after this.

engage._about: INT107 (Dom): maxEngaged 2 = Pitborn and Sobek can be on you together (both brains attack the player; target = nearest engaged, switches when another is nearer by retargetMarginM; finisherWithOthers false = plain death while another enemy is engaged). 1 = the duel stays 1 v 1 (the sim and the camera are tuned for it); a camp of 2 is a later Dom decision. spawnMinDistance: a creature whose timer ran out while you stand in its zone appears only when you are at least this far from its spot, or when you arrive through a gate (hidden by the flash); in a small arena that means it appears when you arrive, never in front of you.

twoFight._about: laneTWOFIGHT v1 (UNPROVEN in Unity): the rules for two enemies on the player at once. skipGivingUp: an enemy that gave up (chase Pause / Home) is neither a target nor a combatant when the target is picked. healTarget: the target is re-picked at once when it is missing, dead or gave up while another enemy is engaged (a finisher ends with player.opponent null). noEngageInFinisher: nobody new engages while a finisher scene runs. killerExempt: an enemy's finisher on the player is blocked only by ANOTHER engaged enemy, not by the killer itself. safeZoneGiveUp: engaged chasers drop aggro and walk home while the player is inside a safe zone (the row hub.json safe.monsters.chasers.atThreshold stopAndGoHome that no code read). resetBarOnSwitch: the boss bar damage trail restarts when the target changes. false = the v108 behaviour of that rule.

crossing._about: cover = the gate's flash: a full-screen ember-white overlay in OnGUI, over the frame where the swap happens. The camera is never cut: it is moved by the same offset and turn as the player. Player input is never locked (no code path locks it). holdMaxSeconds: if an additive zone scene is not ready by then the cover stays up (a heavy hold, never a loading bar).
